name: Cleric Missionary
body:
Some clerics have a less martial bent, but their talents of persuasion are still immeasurably useful to any church seeking to grow its flock and influence.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

Missionaries are not proficient with medium armor or shields (except bucklers).

This alters the cleric’s armor proficiency.

Rhetorical Skill

A missionary adds Knowledge (geography) and Knowledge (local) to his list of class skills. He gains a number of skill ranks equal to 4 + his Intelligence modifier at each level, instead of the normal 2 + his Intelligence modifier.

This alters the cleric’s class skills and skill ranks per level.

Divine Persuader (Ex)

A missionary must choose the conversion, redemption or reformation inquisition as one of his domains. In addition, a missionary receives a bonus equal to 1/2 of his level on all Diplomacy and Knowledge (religion) checks. These bonuses double on checks to convert a target to the missionary’s faith.

This ability alters domains.
